notes.content:

[/list]

notes.title: Carve your time away with Pine: A Story of Loss
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=k7o2OHLBEVw;full][/previewyoutube]Today we can’t state just how proud we are to be bringing you diverse games that tell meaningful stories with the launch of Pine: A Story of Loss on Steam.

Pine: A Story of Loss tells an intimate, emotional story that touches lightly on typical gameplay mechanics. You will step into a beautifully illustrated forest glade, where a woodworker struggles with his daily chores as he is interrupted by the cherished memories of his lost loved one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993611/07bb32a7377b28effe0942b940ecdb9cb31ffd5b.png[/img]
For the original concept, professional illustrator (Dreamworks, Nickelodeon) and children’s book author [url=https://www.instagram.com/tomwilltell/?hl=en]Tom Booth[/url] joined with friend and programmer Najati Imam to form Made Up Games. They considered video, short novels, illustrations, and more before settling on a short video game experience to tell the story of the grieving woodworker - which echoes how Tom sat with his own grief and initially made the illustrations of the [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/Btmzim5gHCY/?hl=en&img_index=1]grieving woodworker[/url] that formed the basis of this wordless, emotional story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993611/1cfa5bfd013006e1c5908fa7d9455d2bb2f69a4e.png[/img]
Pine: A Story of Loss is an interactive experience that will feel familiar to those of us who have lost a loved one, as Tom drew on his own experience with grief and loss when creating a game about life after love.

Due to its focus on grief, this is not a game for everyone. There are, however, moments of beauty and hope interwoven throughout the story as the woodworker processes his grief. It is a personal experience that will affect everyone differently because grief touches everyone in different ways.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47019/Pine_A_Story_of_Loss_Collectors_Edition/

If you would like to support the developers for bringing this emotional experience to life and immerse yourself in the game’s wonderful art and music, the Pine: A Story of Loss Collector’s Edition is available for 10% off as part of celebrating the game’s launch.

If you would like to learn more about Pine: A Story of Loss, follow the developers Made Up Games on [url=https://x.com/TallTomsTales]X/Twitter[/url], follow developer and illustrator [url=https://www.instagram.com/tomwilltell/?hl=en]Tom Booth[/url] on Instagram, follow us on [url=https://x.com/FellowTravellr]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@fellowtravellergames]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/fellowtravellergames]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.threads.net/@fellowtravellergames]Threads[/url], or [url=https://bsky.app/profile/fellowtraveller.games]Bluesky[/url], or join our [url=http://bit.ly/FellowTravellerDiscord]official Discord[/url].

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993611/522cf0f8e4526cefefc1725fecfe0402a1d04dcc.png[/img]

We're excited to announce that Pine: A Story of Loss will release on Steam on December 13. Yes, just three days away!

Pine: A Story of Loss is a wordless single-serving game that touches lightly on gameplay mechanics while telling the emotional story of a grieving woodworker who is grappling with his grief.

Professional illustrator (Dreamworks, Nickelodeon) and children’s book author Tom Booth worked with friend and programmer Najati Imam to create Pine: A Story of Loss, which was inspired by Tom’s personal journey with grief. The idea for Pine grew wings when Tom’s illustration of a sad woodworker went viral. This interactive experience will feel familiar to those who have lost a loved one.

We look forward to being able to share Pine with you very, very soon.

notes.title: Fellow Traveller Presents Pine: A Story of Loss
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=FWOe4nK-e-4;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re thrilled to unveil Pine: A Story of Loss, a debut game from New York-based developer Made Up Games. Following the tale of a woodworker grieving the recent passing of his wife, the game is a poignant and reflective story told through wordless interaction and hand-drawn animation. Pine: A Story of Loss will launch in late 2024!

[h2][i]A story of life after love[/i][/h2]

Alone in the forest glade where he made a home with his wife, a woodworker struggles to move on as his simple daily chores are interspersed by cherished memories of a past life. As each season changes, the woodworker must prepare for what’s to come. Tasks such as collecting water, thatching the roof, or planting crops each bring back vivid memories of his wife. Desperate to not let his wife go, the woodworker captures these moments in beautiful wood carvings. Yet, while each one is a promise to her memory, they soon become a dangerous obsession.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025617/f85e54b5d68e8e58fbf82c8be05425a5bad4f13f.jpg[/img]

[h2][i]Environmental storytelling with beautiful hand-drawn animation[/i][/h2]

Designed to be enjoyed in one or two sittings, Pine will immerse you in the woodworker’s world with environmental storytelling, ambient soundscapes, and an original musical score. Everyday chores such as tending to his garden and gathering wood for the next winter are conveyed through charming puzzles and mini-games, with beautiful landscapes that transform with the four seasons. Pine’s artwork features impressionistic environments inspired by works such as the likes of N.C. Wyeth. These gorgeous backgrounds contrast against the clean character animations of the game, inspired by classic comics such as Tintin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025617/41ae1300ba8e3c06bed03f2c819c06ac6f9201f9.jpg[/img]

[h2][i]No one is alone in their grief[/i][/h2]

Pine is developed by Made Up Games, led by professional illustrator and children’s book author Tom Booth and programmer Najati Imam. The woodworker’s first inception was in a sketch created by Booth following a tragic loss, which sparked an outpouring of support from fans who resonated with the powerful depiction of grief. Determined to bring the woodworker’s story to life, Booth and Imam transformed it into Pine, an emotional and interactive experience that serves as a reminder that no one is alone in their loss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025617/9cc4844cd7492334c5082d218feee53bca139978.jpg[/img]

To stay tuned with Pine: A Story of Loss updates and announcements as they go live, follow [url=https://twitter.com/fellowtravellr]Fellow Traveller[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/madeupgamesbk]Made Up Games[/url] on Twitter/X.
